summary: Discover the keys to a successful performance management system in our training. Gain insights and tools to elevate your team's performance and drive results.
lede: Managing performance training helps managers and HR professionals set clear goals, track results and guide people through regular performance conversations. It covers translating strategy into meaningful KPIs, giving feedback based on data and evidence, addressing underperformance and connecting reviews with development, so leaders can design or improve a consistent system for managing performance throughout the year.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly set goals, evaluate performance, and drive results through people.
audience: Heads of department and unit managers
modules: Translating Strategy into Goals and KPIs
Monitoring Progress and Giving Ongoing Feedback
Conducting Effective Performance Reviews and Appraisals
Linking Performance to Rewards, Recognition, and Consequences
Managing Bias, Fairness, and Legal Considerations
Building and Sustaining a Performance Culture
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of management principles and experience in team or project leadership roles.
